notes:
The guide glides: rows and the timeline scroll smoothly instead of jumping, and the highlight fades in as you move
More guide days: Settings > Guide days (1 to 7 days ahead, 3 to start with). ⏩ and ⏪ jump a whole day
Catch-up goes back as far as your provider keeps it, up to 7 days (was 3)
Richer show details: season and episode, the episode's title, genre, and a NEW tag on first showings, where your guide provides them
The TV guide downloads once more after this update to pick up the extra details
Starts from the channel list saved on the box instead of waiting for your provider, then updates it in the background
The guide no longer goes blank while a new one downloads: the one you had stays up until the new one is ready
Faster channel changes, most of all after watching one channel for a while
Opening the channel that's playing in the preview window goes full screen straight away, with no reloading
Smoother guide: scrolling no longer waits on storage, and each frame does far less work
Pause & rewind can't fill the drive any more: when space is tight it keeps less than 30 minutes
Recordings stop cleanly before the drive is full, and long or back-to-back recordings are no longer cut short
